blocks.x: What Smart Contract Engineering & Audit means at Achala IT Solutions: the scope we sign, the architecture we ship, the evidence generated in-flight, and the per workflow outcomes measured against your audited baseline.
This page covers Smart Contract Engineering & Audit the way we deliver it: the pattern, the stack it runs on, the guards we ship and the artifacts your team holds at the first quarter close.

blocks.title: Signed provenance chain — Smart Contract Engineering & Audit
blocks.note: The chain anchors evidence, not data dumps — audit exports re-verify against the anchor and fail loudly if history has been edited.

blocks.x: Every component in Smart Contract Engineering & Audit has a contract, a version and a named owner. When something drifts, the ticket goes to a person, not to a committee — that is what the reference architecture is for.

The build sequence is deliberate: contracts and identity first, the working decision slice second, the verification harness third — because a Smart Contract Engineering & Audit capability without its eval gate is just another unattended automation.

items: The ledger used where tamper-evidence earns its cost — everything else stays a database with a backup.
Personal data never written on-ledger — hashes and references only, verified in design review.
Keys rotated on ceremony with HSM custody — the compromise of one secret is never the compromise of the estate.
